digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate; ticket reconciliation; CLI registry; configuration composition; outbound lifecycle protocol
propositions: Five recovered approved-but-lossy RP decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed briefs mapping behavioral invariants, hard-won test oracles, architectural intent, implementation seams, migration hazards, and maintainer choices before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 transaction semantics must recover exact-match retirement (tombstone/forward/reverse identity overlap) as an ordered no-op on repeat, aborting on ambiguity; RP-03 consumes coherent post-recovery snapshots and owns TicketPlan orchestration without duplicating persistence recovery.

RP-03 must enforce singular retry ownership: concrete adapters own physical request/subprocess/SDK retry; reconciler owns operation intent/postcondition, commit_unknown, write-ahead recovery, re-observation, dependency deferral, and a scoped three-consecutive finite-pass fuse (max 3 total invocations, 15s cumulative sleep per logical operation, 3-consecutive exhausted across >=2 tickets opens endpoint/provider scope).

RP-04 centralizes explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence with per-operation snapshots and separate secret/provider boundaries, requiring explicit CLI-over-environment precedence correction and removal of Cloud adapter-local fallback.

RP-05 and RP-06 require decision-ready briefs for CLI routing/help normalization, review-policy effective-applicability reversal, typed failure semantics, checkpoint digest-completion, and explicit --retry authority with fresh per-invocation budgets.
